name: amfx-gasoline-labor-hours-research
description: amFX reproduction (24JAN23 p4): Gas affordability approximation. Original chart shows hours of work per gallon (gas price / hourly earnings). Since CES0500000003 is unavailable, we show nominal gas price vs CPI-adjusted real gas price as a proxy for affordability trends. The real price shows gas is not as expensive as nominal suggests.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: GAS AFFORDABILITY (24JAN23 p4)
# =============================================================================
# Nominal vs CPI-adjusted gas price.
# =============================================================================

# Gas price per gallon (weekly, forward-filled to daily)
gas_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GASREGW')()
gas = ffill(gas_src.result)

# CPI for real adjustment (monthly, forward-filled)
cpi_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CPIAUCSL')()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)

# Real gas price (CPI-adjusted, base period 2009 CPI ~ 215)
cpi_base = 215.0
real_gas = gas * (cpi_base / cpi)

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Is Gas Really Getting More Expensive? Nominal vs Real Price',
    category='Gas Affordability',
    y_axis_label='Price ($/gallon)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Nominal Gas Price', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Real Gas Price (CPI-Adj)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, gas, real_gas)
